purpose: A small info-circle button placed next to a label or field; it opens a tooltip that explains them.

notFor.case: An icon button that runs an action.
An explanation that must stay visible, such as helper text.
Rich content, links or actions behind the icon.

Default.visual: The icon in the Variant's ink: Action/primary/default (default), Content/secondary (secondary, inverse), Status/critical/content (critical), Status/info/content (info).

Hover.visual: The icon moves to Action/primary/hover (default), Content/primary (secondary, inverse), Status/critical/surface-solid (critical) or Status/info/surface-solid (info).

Focused.visual: The icon keeps its Default ink; a focus stroke in Border/focus (Border/strong for secondary and inverse, Status/critical/border-strong or Status/info/border-strong for critical and info) with the Border/ring/default ring (Status/critical/border or Status/info/border for the status variants).

a11y.role: button (the trigger of a Radix Tooltip)
a11y.keyboard: Tab reaches it; keyboard focus opens its tooltip and Escape hides it (Radix Tooltip).
notes: Needs an aria-label: the button has no visible text.
The drawn box is 18 · 20 · 24 (sm · default · lg, tooltip-contract.md), so sm and default rely on a larger hit area to reach 24.

openQuestions: Motion: the State axis has Hover, Open and Focused but the contract has no motion decision (recipes/motion.ts has no entry). Should the ink change ease on use-hover like other controls? (finding MOT-002 TooltipInfoTrigger)
Touch screens have no hover: should a tap open the tooltip?
The sm and default boxes are 18 and 20 px: is the 24 px hit area padded in code, or must the drawn box grow?
